blocks.text: Blockchain system kuch aham hisson (components) se mil kar banta hai:

items: Node: node woh computer hai jo blockchain network mein shamil hota hai. Har node blockchain ki copy rakhta hai aur transactions aur blocks ki jaanch (validate) mein madad karta hai.

Ledger: ledger blockchain par hone wali tamam transactions ka digital record (hisaab ka register) hai. Yeh tamam nodes mein phaila (distributed) hota hai, taake network mein har ek ke paas wahi maloomat ho.
Block: block transactions ka ek bundle (group) hai. Har block mein ek unique pehchan (hash), pichhle block ka reference (parent hash) aur transactions ki list hoti hai.
Transaction: transaction blockchain ka ek alag entry hai. Yeh network ke participants (hissa lene wale) ke darmiyan kisi asset (qeemti cheez) ya maloomat ki transfer dikhata hai.

Blockchain Protocol: protocol woh rules aur tareeqe tay karta hai ke transactions ki jaanch kaise hogi, blocks chain mein kaise jurenge, aur consensus (sab ka agree karna) kaise hoga. Yeh network ki integrity (data ka sahi aur poora rehna) aur hifazat yaqeeni banata hai.

blocks.text: Yeh program teen blocks ki chhoti si chain banata hai: har block ka hash us ke data aur pichhle block ke hash (parent hash) dono se banta hai (hashlib Python ki library hai jo hash nikalti hai). changed_block ya changed_data badal kar Run karein: jis block ka data badla, us ka aur us ke baad ke har block ka hash badal jata hai, is liye tabdeeli foran pakri jati hai. changed_block = -1 rakhein to sab blocks theek aayenge.

import hashlib

blocks = ["Ali -> Sara: 500", "Sara -> Bilal: 200", "Bilal -> Ali: 100"]
changed_block = 1                  # is number ke block ka data badla jayega (-1 = koi nahi)
changed_data = "Sara -> Bilal: 900"


def block_hash(data, parent_hash):
    # Hash block ke data AUR pichhle block ke hash (parent hash) dono se banta hai
    return hashlib.sha256((parent_hash + data).encode()).hexdigest()[:10]


# Asal chain ke hash yaad rakh lein
saved = list()
parent = "0" * 10              # pehle block ka koi parent nahi
for data in blocks:
    parent = block_hash(data, parent)
    saved.append(parent)

# Ab ek block ka data chupke se badlein aur poori chain dobara jaanchein
if 0 <= changed_block < len(blocks):
    blocks[changed_block] = changed_data
parent = "0" * 10
for i in range(len(blocks)):
    parent = block_hash(blocks[i], parent)
    status = "theek" if parent == saved[i] else "TABDEELI PAKRI GAYI"
    print("Block", i, "| asal hash", saved[i], "| naya hash", parent, "|", status)

blocks.prompt: Distributed ledger ki structure samjhaiye aur bataiye ke ise decentralized kyun rakha jata hai (exercise long question 1).
blocks.explanation: Structure: ledger blocks ki chain hai; har block mein transactions, apna hash aur pichhle block ka hash (parent hash) hota hai, is liye blocks order mein (ek ke baad ek) jure rehte hain. Network ka har node poori copy rakhta hai aur protocol ke rules aur consensus se naye blocks jaanchta hai. Decentralization ki wajah: kisi ek central authority par bharosa nahi karna parta; ek jagah kharabi se system nahi rukta; chhed chhaar foran pakri jati hai kyunke baqi copies se mel nahi khati; aur sab participants ek hi transparent (saaf, sab ke saamne) record dekh sakte hain.

items: Components: node, ledger, block (hash + parent hash + transactions), transaction, protocol.
Parent hash blocks ko chain mein jorta hai.
